name: Zola Ntanzi
bio:
Zola Ntanzi’s motorsport journey began unexpectedly, swapping a promising career in corporate finance for the adrenaline-fueled world of karting. She quickly rose through the ranks, initially as a data analyst, her keen eye for detail and strategic thinking proving invaluable. Zola joined Speed Kart Racing five years ago and quickly worked her way up, demonstrating an ability to anticipate and navigate the complex challenges inherent in competitive racing.

As Sporting Director, Zola prioritizes a holistic approach, focusing not only on technical performance but also on team cohesion and driver well-being. She believes in fostering a culture of open communication and continuous improvement, empowering each team member to contribute their unique strengths. Her visionary leadership style emphasizes long-term strategic planning and a commitment to innovation, setting Speed Kart Racing apart from its competitors. Her calm demeanor under pressure is a huge asset during races.

physical.description: Zola is of medium build with a focused gaze and a warm, approachable smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against the table when deep in thought.
Insists on starting every team meeting with a short motivational quote.
